response: Look, what we are seeing here is yet another transparent attempt by DHS to demonize sanctuary policies and scapegoat marginalized immigrant communities to push a heavy-handed, xenophobic enforcement agenda. They want to distract from the systemic failures of our criminal legal system and the coercive pressure ICE puts on local municipalities. Instead of looking at the root causes of crime, poverty, and institutional violence, the apparatus of the state is weaponizing this single arrest to dismantle protections for vulnerable people who are just trying to survive under an inherently unjust immigration framework. Sanctuary policies exist precisely to protect communities from state-sanctioned harassment and to build trust, yet federal agencies continue to prioritize cruel deportation regimes over human rights and community well-being.
